item.title: View Cluster Basic Information
item.description: This section describes how to view cluster basic information. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Cluster Settings View permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Cluster Settings View permissions and enter your cluster. Click Cluster Settings > Basic Information in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Edit Cluster Basic Information
item.description: This section describes how to edit cluster basic information. Note KubeSphere does not support modifying the name of an already added cluster. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Cluster Settings Management permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Cluster Settings Management permissions and enter your cluster.
